evidence.notes: Local SOQL validates HAVING references, aggregate aliases, grouped-field consistency, and aggregate field types before execution; dynamic query failures are catchable QueryException values.

source.content: List<Object> rows = [SELECT Rating, COUNT(Id) accountCount, SUM(AnnualRevenue) totalRevenue FROM Account GROUP BY Rating HAVING Rating = 'Hot' AND totalRevenue > 100]; System.assertEquals(1, rows.size()); Object row = rows.get(0); System.assertEquals('Hot', row.Rating); Boolean havingCaught = false; try { Database.query('SELECT Rating, COUNT(Id) accountCount FROM Account GROUP BY Rating HAVING Missing__c = ''x'''); } catch (QueryException qe) { havingCaught = qe.getMessage().contains('Missing__c'); } System.assert(havingCaught); Boolean ungroupedCaught = false; try { Database.query('SELECT Rating, COUNT(Id) accountCount FROM Account GROUP BY Rating HAVING Name = ''Acme'''); } catch (QueryException qe) { ungroupedCaught = qe.getMessage().contains('must be grouped or aggregated'); } System.assert(ungroupedCaught); Boolean aggregateFieldCaught = false; try { Database.query('SELECT SUM(Name) bad FROM Account'); } catch (QueryException qe) { aggregateFieldCaught = qe.getMessage().contains('SUM requires numeric field Name'); } System.assert(aggregateFieldCaught); Boolean aliasCaught = false; try { Database.query('SELECT Rating, COUNT(Id) Rating FROM Account GROUP BY Rating'); } catch (QueryException qe) { aliasCaught = qe.getMessage().contains('conflicts with grouped field'); } System.assert(aliasCaught);
